course.title: Linear Integrated Circuits and Digital Systems

content.value: A 4-bit R-2R D/A converter is constructed to control the speed of a small DC motor using the output of a digital logic circuit. If the logic circuit uses 10 V CMOS devices, calculate the analogue output voltage from the D/A converter when the input code is hexadecimal number "B”. Also determine the resolution of the D/A converter.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
